// diagnostic

E-OSTARGET-DISPATCH-EXHAUSTIVE

This `#build.target.os` dispatch doesn't cover every target OS — missing: {list}.

What

This `#build.target.os` dispatch doesn't cover every target OS — missing: {list}.

Why

A build can target any OS of the list, native, web, Wasm or freestanding, so the dispatch must handle each one — otherwise a build for a missing OS would have no arm to run.

Fix

Add an arm for each missing OS ({list}), or name several in one arm, such as `.Web | .Wasm -> …`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-OSTARGET-DISPATCH-EXHAUSTIVE: tests/ui/os_target_dispatch_native_only.stderr.
